snippet.title: I Have No Change — Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426150
Join Discord: https://discord.gg/GDupbvvWzs

A first-person narrative game that immerses you in the atmosphere of a night kiosk filled with stories, melancholy, and reflections of residents from Russia's regions.

Winter. New Year's Eve. A night kiosk.

This is where 27-year-old Matvey works, serving all kinds of customers — from familiar faces to wandering strangers. On the other side of the kiosk’s window, their stories unfold: about good and bad, life and death, how Vitya cheated on Masha, and how the building on Stroiteley Street is once again without hot water.

During these festive nights, alone with his thoughts, Matvey keeps asking himself:
How did he end up in this kiosk? Did he ever dream of such a life? Is he ready for change?

Let’s take a closer look inside this small kiosk and discover the large world hiding behind its fragile walls.
